population.span: Investigator-initiated, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial among 360 consecutive candidates for cardiac surgery enrolled in 11 Italian centers between March 2012 and March 2014.

endpoint.span: main secondary study end points were postoperative AF and pericardial or pleural effusion.

estimate.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

ci.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomized to receive placebo (n=180) or colchicine (0.5 mg twice daily in patients \u226570 kg or 0.5 mg once daily in patients <70 kg; n=180) starting between 48 and 72 hours before surgery and continued for 1 month after surgery.

follow_up.span: PROTOCOL PRIMARY OUTCOME: Post-pericardiotomy syndrome, post-operative effusions, post-operative atrial fibrillation incidence | Incidence of the outcomes at 3 months from cardiac surgery | TIME FRAME: 3 months

absent_reason.analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis population for the 61 versus 75 postoperative AF events as intention-to-treat or all randomized. The explicitly named on-treatment analysis reports different counts.

served_mismatch: The served event counts match the abstract. However, the reported effect and confidence interval are an absolute difference, not an RR. The served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly supported, and the in-hospital/index-admission timepoint is not stated: the registry specifies 3 months, while the abstract does not explicitly time the AF estimate.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The registry specifies adult cardiac-surgery candidates, excluding cardiac transplantation; the estimate's intention-to-treat status remains unstated.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Age \> 18years * Candidate to cardiac surgery but cardiac transplantation * Informed consent

notes: Follow-up and adult eligibility use registry spans. The registry timepoint describes the protocol and does not establish the abstract estimate's actual observation window. The reported positive absolute difference follows placebo minus colchicine. Randomized arm sizes are 180 each, but analysis denominators are not explicitly stated for the bound estimate. No RR or RR confidence interval was inferred.
